key_points: Analyst downgrade led to a 2.7% intraday drop in WMT stock.
Class I recall over possible salmonella contamination introduces short-term safety concerns.
Walmart's $15M pledge to feed millions and food‑bank grant are positive but minor in scale.
Digital shelf label updates and AI shopping tests in India are neutral to slightly positive developments.
Select Sam’s Club stores adding a new brisket‑and‑cheddar sausage is a negligible product tweak.
